note: The packages the sandboxes run (nix/README.md). Each is a BinSpec's `nix` attribute with `pinned: true` (packages/browser bins.ts, packages/sandbox bins.ts); a test checks the lists agree. `run` is dither-bins, built at the manager's start; `forks` is dither-bins-forks, the servers built from forks this project keeps, built after it and only once a backend that needs them is in use; `test` is what only the tests run (continuwuity: the Matrix homeserver test/chat-parity runs against).
